name: POST /api/speech/voices/preview - Preview a TTS voice with the tenant's own key
description: Speaks up to 300 characters with one of the tenant's own TTS keys so a voice can be heard before it is chosen (7227c780-62bf-4956-b678-56562cd0ed74#AC3 — a tenant can preview a TTS voice with its own key). Body: binding_id (a tenant credential bound for the tts layer: openai, elevenlabs, cartesia or deepgram), text, optional voice, model (default: the provider's certified catalog TTS model) and language (default en). Returns {preview: {provider_id, model, voice, characters, content_type, audio_base64, estimated_cost}} — estimated_cost is the list price for per-character models, else null. The call goes straight to the provider with the tenant's key; nothing is billed by the platform. Provider rejections map to typed errors whose messages never include the key: 422 KeyRejected (401/403), 429 RateLimited, 502 ProviderError, 400 for a refused model/voice. A key bound for another layer is 400; another tenant's binding is 404; a revoked one 409. The API test runner has no genuine TTS key, so testCases[0] is the deterministic not-a-tts-key refusal using the tenant's LLM credential; the audio path is exercised against provider stubs (every provider's request shape, default voices, error mapping).

testCases.name: The tenant's LLM credential is not a TTS key

errorCases.message: binding <id> is a <layer> key, not a tts key
errorCases.when: the binding is not a tts key, text is missing or over 300 chars, the provider has no preview, a voice is required, or the provider refused model/voice
the provider throttles the tenant key
